title: How to Broadcast Automated SMS Panic Alerts for Critical Labs
content:
ARTICLE: How to Broadcast Automated SMS Panic Alerts for Critical Labs (KA-025)
SYSTEM: LIS Engine
DEPARTMENT: Laboratory Operations
VERSION: 2.1
OVERVIEW: This comprehensive operating guide details how hospital personnel should interact with the LIS Engine module to execute how to broadcast automated sms panic alerts for critical labs safely and reliably.
STEPS:
Step 1: Open the LIS Engine client terminal on any networked SMCH workstation and log in with role credentials.
Step 2: Enter the patient's unique UHID or Case Number to load active records.
Step 3: Access the designated submenu corresponding to How to Broadcast Automated SMS Panic Alerts for Critical Labs and verify current patient status.
Step 4: Input all required clinical or administrative parameters, ensuring mandatory fields are validated.
Step 5: Verify preview confirmation modal and click 'Submit' to persist changes to the database.
Step 6: Print barcode, acknowledgement chit, or receipt as required by hospital compliance.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Connection timeout: Verify LAN cable connection or contact IT Helpdesk.
- [ISSUE & FIX] Permission Denied: Ensure user account has the assigned role in staff master permissions.
Contact Laboratory Operations coordinator or IT Operations Support at Extension 1033 (Email: it@smch.in).
